Bars sorted by group order. Range spans 10³·⁹ (M₁₁) to 10⁵³·⁹ (Monster).
σ₁(2ᵉ) = 2ᵉ⁺¹ − 1 is a string of e+1 ones in binary.

The Prime Shells — Ogg primes at the core
Every prime organised by SUPPORT (which series first needs it) and, in the core, by EXPONENT in |M|.
The 15 Ogg (supersingular) primes are the core; each outer shell is a series that breaks out of it. All machine-checked in Lean.
